description: Source code for the FilePath class implementation, handling file path manipulations such as component extraction, extension handling, path normalization, and platform-specific path considerations.

classes.name: FilePath
classes.description: Represents and manipulates file system paths, providing methods for component extraction, extension handling, path normalization, and platform-specific path considerations.

methods.name: GetComponents
methods.description: Extracts individual components of the file path into a vector.

methods.name: DirName
methods.description: Returns the directory part of the path.

methods.name: BaseName
methods.description: Returns the filename component of the path.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns the extension of the filename.

methods.name: FinalExtension
methods.description: Returns the last extension of the filename, considering double extensions.

methods.name: RemoveExtension
methods.description: Removes the extension from the filename.

methods.name: RemoveFinalExtension
methods.description: Removes the last extension from the filename.

methods.name: InsertBeforeExtension
methods.description: Inserts a suffix before the extension.

methods.name: AddExtension
methods.description: Adds an extension to the filename.

methods.name: ReplaceExtension
methods.description: Replaces the current extension with a new one.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a component or path to the current path.

methods.name: IsAbsolute
methods.description: Checks if the path is absolute.

methods.name: EndsWithSeparator
methods.description: Checks if the path ends with a separator.

methods.name: AsEndingWithSeparator
methods.description: Returns the path ending with a separator.

methods.name: StripTrailingSeparators
methods.description: Removes trailing separators from the path.

methods.name: ReferencesParent
methods.description: Checks if the path references the parent directory.

methods.name: LossyDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display name suitable for lossy display.

methods.name: MaybeAsASCII
methods.description: Returns the path as an ASCII string if possible.

methods.name: As8Bit
methods.description: Returns the path as an 8-bit string.

methods.name: NormalizePathSeparators
methods.description: Normalizes path separators to the platform default.

methods.name: NormalizePathSeparatorsTo
methods.description: Normalizes path separators to a specified character.
